messages:
Ella: Quick thought  Friday evening bridgewalk + bites + beers? Meet at 6:10 by the lobby, short stroll over to the riverfront vendors. Low-key. :bridge_at_night::beer:
Omar: Love this. 6:10 works. Can we aim for 6:30? I have a late demo.
Ella: 6:30 ok, shifting start.
Nina: I'll come if there's a veggie option. Any idea which vendors are open late?
Samir: There's a wood-fired pizza truck that stays til 9, plus a kebab stand. Vegan pizza slice available sometimes.
Ella: I'll DM the vendor hours and pin in the event.
ops-bot: FYI: public gatherings at riverfront are fine but company rooftop/indoor bookings require Facilities approval. For company-organized groups >12, file: https://intranet/redwood/facilities-request
Omar: Small poll: BYO cup/plate vs single-use provided  react with :cup_with_straw: or :plate_with_cutlery: ?
Nina: :cup_with_straw: prefer reusable.
Samir: :plate_with_cutlery: single-use for simplicity.
Ella: I'll bring a small tote of reusable plates/cups just in case. Who wants to be tip-captain?
Omar: I can handle cash tips and keep receipts.
Nina: Partners welcome? Might bring mine.
Ella: Partners welcome but keep group small if space tight. First-come RSVP for close seating.
Samir: I'll add a quick event on the calendar and a pin with vendor list + walking route.
Ella: Sweet. Tentative: Friday 18:30 meet lobby, walk to riverfront, grab food, hang for ~90 mins. See RSVP. :sun_with_face:
